parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Choose from the cells labelled **1** to **5** in Fig. 4.1 to identify the cell in which:

• the nuclear envelope is reassembling

• the spindle begins to form

• there is a high rate of transcription and translation

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Cell **2** is in a stage of mitosis that occurs before the stage of mitosis shown in cell **1**.

Outline the changes that would occur from the stage of mitosis shown in cell **2** to the stage shown in cell **1**.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Suggest why some cells in Fig. 4.1 appear empty, with no nucleus or chromosomes.
